note: Port Jefferson's Sunday farmers market at Harborfront Park, with local farms, bakers and food makers along the harbor. Free to browse.
The outdoor country auction held on the grounds of the Mather House Museum, home of the Historical Society of Greater Port Jefferson. Come to bid or just browse.
Port Jefferson's fall Harvest Festival, organized by the Greater Port Jefferson Chamber of Commerce. Check the Chamber's website for the full schedule of activities.
The Port Jefferson Business Improvement District's holiday tree lighting at the corner of Main Street and East Broadway.
A 4K run named for Caleb Brewster, the whaleboat captain of the Revolutionary War's Culper Spy Ring. Register through the organizer.
A ticketed chowder tasting walk through Port Jefferson restaurants, run by the Greater Port Jefferson Chamber of Commerce. Buy tickets on the Chamber's website.
Vintage and classic cars make their run up Port Jefferson's historic hill climb route, reviving a village tradition from the early 1900s. A reception follows at the Village Center.
The Three Village Historical Society's annual Culper Spy Day, with Revolutionary War spy history at sites across Setauket and Stony Brook. Details on the Society's website.
